title: Population stationary geometry for profiled Ds
statement: For atomless P with finite second moments and a quantizer with positive cell masses and nonsingular I_q, bounded-packet first-order stationarity of Phi_Ds is equivalent to a.e. assignment to the nearest projected centroid e_b=C mu_b of the efficient projection e(s)=Cs in the S_psi(I_q)^{-1} metric (G_s = C^T S_psi^{-1} C). The rule reproduces the partition iff projected centroids are pairwise distinct and tie hyperplanes are null; stationarity does not force distinct projected centroids.

proof_location.section: DS12. Population stationary geometry for profiled \(D_s\)

assumptions: all cell masses positive, I_q nonsingular (hence nuisance block nonsingular)
stationarity tested against bounded-barycenter packet relocations
atomlessness is load-bearing only for necessity (stationary => nearest rule); sufficiency holds for every P
deployability characterization read selection-independently: the nearest-centroid correspondence is a.e. single-valued and reproduces q iff centroids are distinct and tie hyperplanes are null
role: population-side geometry of the finite-to-population bridge
